capabilities: Search and import book metadata from Open Library, or enter books manually
Track reading states and log reading sessions with start and end dates
Organize books into shelves and dynamic folder structures
Capture quotes with page numbers, tags, and stable block IDs
View reading statistics, shelves, and yearly reading challenges in sidebar views
extras: Not yet available in the Community Plugins directory; manual installation requires cloning the repository and building with npm. Goodreads CSV import/export is on the roadmap, not implemented.
intentEvidence: It provides a local-first alternative to services like Goodreads
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track books, reading progress, and quotes, so readers rely on external services like Goodreads.

relations.evidence: Open Library Integration: Search and import book metadata including Title, Author, ISBN, Page Count, and Cover URLs.
It provides a local-first alternative to services like Goodreads

summary: Book tracking and library management plugin that imports book metadata from Open Library, tracks reading states and sessions, and shows reading statistics.
